page.layout: One block of running text in a single column, with the page number and running head printed at the top. The right edge of the scan cuts off the ends of lines. No margin notes, no footnotes.

main_text.l: gis etiam vel minus in sefe mutuo
minus autem acria minori; fermè verò
docet Sylvius praxeos suae cap. II. I
authoritas qui libro de victu acutorum
ὀξέος, effervescentiam passa cum acido: effer-
vescit igitur bilis cum Succo subacido
μεταπεξόμενα qua usus fuerat Hippocrates, ne sibi
omniscii, uti ibi loqui amat, Galeni probat.

page.notes: The right edge is cropped, so the last letters of many lines are missing; I have not supplied them. The Greek words are rendered approximately from the scan and may contain small errors. Marked as doubtful: the Greek phrases at "μετα-πεξόμενα" and "μεταπεξόμενα" on the lines around "amara dissolvi" and "vocem".
